DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

For the creamy chicken filling : 2 tbsp butter  1/2 cup yellow onion, finely chopped  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced  2 cup rotisserie chicken , shredded  Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  1 tsp paprika powder  1 tsp red chili flakes 1/4 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream  5 tbsp cream cheese  1/4 cup green onion, chopped  1/4 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tbsp parsley, chopped  To assemble  6 sliced bread of choice  1 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded  Butter for toasting  Method: Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken, garlic powder, black pepper, paprika and chili flakes. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes so the seasonings coat the chicken. Lower the heat. Add the cream cheese and heavy cream, stirring until smooth and combined. Fold in the Parmesan. If the mixture is too thick, add heavy cream a teaspoon at a time. Stir in the green onion and parsley. Taste before adding salt. The mixture should be creamy and thick, not runny. Butter the outside of each bread slice. On the inside, layer mozzarella, a generous amount of creamy chicken, more mozzarella and the second slice of bread. Divide the filling and cheese evenly among three sandwiches. Cook over medium-low heat for about 3–4 minutes per side, until the bread is deeply golden and crisp and the cheese has melted. Cover the pan briefly if needed to help the center melt, then uncover to keep the crust crisp. Let each sandwich rest for about a minute before slicing and enjoy. #recipe #garlicparmesan #sandwich #cheese

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

LAZY CINNAMON ROLL APPLE PIE 🍏🥧✨ This recipe has gone viral every time I’ve shared it over the years, it’s one of those warm, cozy classics that makes its way onto our table every holiday. Perfect for Thanksgiving, family get-togethers, or an easy Christmas morning breakfast! You can even prep it the night before and pop it in the oven the next morning! 🎄 Ingredients 🍏  1 can refrigerated cinnamon rolls (with icing) 1 can apple pie filling (21 oz) ¼ cup heavy cream 4 tbsp melted butter ½ cup brown sugar ½ cup all-purpose flour ½ tsp cinnamon DIRECTIONS🥧 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. Pour the heavy cream into the bottom of a greased pie dish or baking dish. 2. Cut your cinnamon rolls into quarters and spread them evenly over the heavy cream. Spoon the apple pie filling right on top. 3. In a bowl, mix the melted butter, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon until you get a crumbly, wet sand texture. Sprinkle evenly over the apples. 4. Bake for 30–35 minutes, or until golden brown and the cinnamon rolls are cooked through. Let cool slightly before drizzling with the icing from the cinnamon roll package! Serve warm with vanilla ice cream if you want to make it extra delicious! 🤎 TIP: You can use homemade apple pie filling or swap in your favorite canned pie filling! To prep ahead, assemble everything, cover, and refrigerate overnight, then bake fresh in the morning. You may need a few extra minutes in the oven! #easyrecipes #quickrecipe #cinnamonrolls #floridablogger #tastewithnicki

🍪 CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE SHOTS 🤎 Cute little chocolate chip cookie shots, perfect for filling with cold milk. Makes 9 cookie shots. Ingredients: • 1½ cups (227 g) all-purpose flour • ⅓ cup (65 g) packed brown sugar • 2 tbsp + 2 tsp (33 g) granulated sugar • ½ tsp baking powder • Pinch of salt • 6 tbsp (88 g) butter • 1 large egg • 1 tsp vanilla paste • ½ cup + 1 tbsp (100 g) mini semi-sweet chocolate chips For the chocolate coating: • 120 g milk chocolate, melted Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly grease the cookie shot mold and inserts. 2. Mix flour, sugars, baking powder, and salt. 3. Melt butter and let cool slightly. Whisk in egg and vanilla paste. 4. Combine wet and dry ingredients, then fold in chocolate chips. 5. Divide dough into 9 balls. Place into the mold and press inserts firmly down. 6. Bake for 17–19 minutes with inserts in place. 7. Trim the edges while warm. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then gently remove inserts and let cool completely. 8. Melt 120 g of milk chocolate and coat the inside of each cookie shot. Let the chocolate set completely, then fill with cold milk and enjoy🤎 #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #dessertrecipes #viralrecipes #christmasdesserts

french dip sandwiches on garlic butter pretzel buns ✨ Ingredients  Beef/Au Jus - 3 lbs chuck roast - 2 tsp onion powder (for beef) - 2 tsp garlic powder (for beef) - Salt and pepper, generously  - 5 cups beef stock - 6 garlic cloves - 3 rosemary sprigs  - 2 yellow onions, sliced - 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  - 1 tbsp roasted beef bouillon paste - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp msg (optional) - Salt to taste  - Avocado oil, for searing Caramelized onions  - 5 yellow onions, sliced  - 1 tbsp butter  - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp granulated sugar  - Salt to taste Roasted garlic horse radish aoii - 1/2 cup mayonnaise - 1 whole head roasted garlic - 1–1 1/2 tbsp prepared horseradish (adjust to taste) - 1 tsp Dijon mustard - 1 tsp lemon juice - 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce - 1/4 tsp black pepper - Salt to taste Extras - Pretzel buns  - Garlic butter  - Provolone Cheese  Instructions - Pat the chuck roast dry and generously season all sides with salt, pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder. - Heat avocado oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the beef on all sides until deeply browned.Remove and set aside. - the same pot, add the sliced onions and cook until softened, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom. - Add the onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Stir until fragrant. - Pour in the beef stock and stir, scraping the bottom of the pot to release all the flavor. - Add Worcestershire sauce, roasted beef bouillon paste, garlic cloves, and rosemary. Stir to combine. - Return the seared chuck roast to the pot. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and cook on low heat forapproximately 4 hours, turning the beef occasionally, until fork-tender and easily shreddable. - Remove the beef and shred with two forks. Strain the cooking liquid and reserve for dipping. Skim excess fat and adjust seasoning to taste. - Heat butter and neutral oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. - Add sliced onions, sugar and a generous pinch of salt. Cook slowly, stirring occasionally,for 35–45 minutes until deeply golden and caramelized. - Slice the pretzel buns and brush the insides with garlic butter. - Toast in a skillet until golden. - Spread roasted garlic horseradish aioli on the buns. Pile on the shredded beef, caramelized onions, and provolone cheese. Broil or cover briefly until the cheese is melted and bubbly. - Serve warm with the reserved beef au jus for dipping. • • • #recipes #recipeideas #fallrecipes #DinnerIdeas

Chicken Pot Pie Bake🔥496 cals 43g protein 14g fat 51g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 24 oz cooked shredded chicken breast (32 oz raw weight) 12 oz frozen mixed vegetables (peas, carrots, corn & green beans) 2 cans (10.5 oz each) 98% fat-free cream of chicken soup 1/2 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt 1/4 cup low-sodium chicken broth 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp dried thyme 1/2 tsp black pepper Salt to taste Biscuit Topping: 1 can (16.3 oz) Pillsbury Grands! Flaky Layers Original Biscuits (8 biscuits) Garlic-Parsley Butter: 1 tbsp butter, melted 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp dried parsley Directions: 1. If starting with raw chicken, place chicken breasts in a pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil, reduce to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for approximately 20-25 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Let rest for 5 minutes, then shred. 2. Preheat oven to 375°F 3. Add cooked shredded chicken, frozen mixed vegetables, cream of chicken soup, greek yogurt, chicken broth, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, black pepper, and salt directly into the baking dish. Mix until evenly combined. 4. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 20 -25 minutes to heat the filling. 5. Remove from the oven and take off the foil. Cut each biscuit into 4 equal pieces and arrange them evenly over the hot chicken mixture, leaving small gaps between the pieces. 6. Return to the oven uncovered and bake for approximately 20-25 minutes, until the biscuits are golden brown and completely cooked through and the filling reaches 165°F. Cover loosely with foil if the tops brown too quickly. 7. While the casserole finishes baking, combine the melted butter, garlic powder, and dried parsley in a small bowl. 8. Remove the finished casserole from the oven and immediately brush the garlic-parsley butter over the hot, golden biscuits - divide into 6 meals & enjoy! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Sticky Chicken & Garlic Noodles  This is an  easy weeknight dinner you can make with spaghetti or ramen noodles. I got this from my friend @mamasdownsouthkitchen 😊 Ingredients Chicken and vegetables: 1½ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ½ tsp black pepper 1 tbsp chili crunch (optional)  1 tsp sesame oil  2 tbsp oil (for cooking)  2 bell peppers, diced 1 onion, diced Sticky garlic sauce: ½ cup soy sauce (used reduced if you are sensitive to salt)  2 tbsp minced garlic ¼ cup honey 3 tbsp hoisin sauce 2 tbsp cornstarch Noodles: 12 oz spaghetti or 4–5 packs of ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded Up to 1 cup reserved noodle cooking water Instructions 1. Toss the diced chicken with the garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, sesame oil, and chili crunch. Set a pot of water on the stove to boil. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned chicken and let it sear. 3. While the chicken sears, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, hoisin sauce, minced garlic, and cornstarch until smooth. 4. Add the diced bell peppers and onion to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften and the chicken is cooked through. 5. Cook the noodles according to the package directions. Reserve some of the cooking water before draining. 6. Stir the minced garlic into the skillet and cook for about 1 minute, until fragrant. Give the sauce another whisk, pour it into the skillet, and stir until it bubbles and thickens. Add the reserved noodle water a splash at a time until the sauce reaches your desired consistency. 7. Add the drained noodles to the skillet and toss until everything is coated in the sticky garlic sauce. Serve warm and enjoy! #easyrecipe #easydinner #dinnerideas #onepotmeals #chickenrecipe

This is dinner on easy mode! 🍲 Stick of Butter Chicken and Rice will be your best friend in the kitchen when you don’t feel like spending hours over the stovetop! Want to make it later? Save this recipe in @myrecipes so it's ready when you are. Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. Sprinkle with fresh parsley if desired. Inspiration: @melissajorealrecipes 🧑‍🍳: @nicolemcmom #easydinners #dinnerideas #butter #chicken #chickenandrice

COWBOY BUTTER CHICKEN ALFREDO 🤠🧈🍝  If you know me, you know I LOVE anything cowboy butter! This was a 10/10!! Creamy, cheesy, packed with SO much flavor, and ready in under 30 minutes!  INGREDIENTS: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cubed * 12 oz pasta * 1 tbsp olive oil @getgraza  *4 tbsp butter * 1½ cups heavy whipping cream (+ a splash more if needed) * 1 cup mozzarella cheese * ½ cup parmesan cheese * ½ cup pepper jack cheese * 1 tbsp Dijon mustard SEASONINGS (ALL TO TASTE): * Kinder’s Cowboy Butter Seasoning @Kinder's Flavors *Garlic powder * Onion powder * Italian seasoning * Paprika * Slap Ya Mama @Slap Ya Mama  * Salt & pepper INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. 2. Season cubed chicken with all seasonings. Cook in olive oil until golden and fully cooked (165°F).   3. Transfer chicken to a plate. Lower heat to medium-low and melt butter in the same skillet. Add the same seasonings and Dijon mustard. 4. Pour in heavy cream and simmer for 2–3 minutes. 5. Sprinkle in mozzarella, parmesan, and pepper jack. Stir until creamy, adding another splash of heavy cream if needed. 6. Add pasta and chicken back in, toss until coated, and serve! I didn’t measure my seasonings, just added everything to taste! Viral Chewy Potatoes with Spicy Orange Glaze 🥔🍊 Prep Time: 15 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 2-3 INGREDIENTS Potato Base 2-3 medium gold potatoes (peeled and roughly chopped) 1/2 cup + 1 tbsp water 3/4 cup tapioca starch 1/2 tsp salt Neutral oil for deep frying Spicy Orange Glaze 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed 1 tsp orange zest 2 tbsp gochujang (Korean chili paste) 1 tbsp honey or brown sugar 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 clove garlic, minced 1 tsp grated fresh ginger 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes or cayenne pepper (optional) 1 tsp sesame oil Garnish Fresh parsley, finely chopped INSTRUCTIONS 1. Place peeled and chopped gold potatoes and water into a blender. Blend on high until completely smooth with zero lumps. 2. Pour the blended potato mixture into a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 30-to-45-second intervals, stirring in between, for about 4–5 minutes total until it turns into a thick, glossy, sticky paste. 3. Stir salt and tapioca starch directly into the hot potato paste. Knead until a smooth, stretchy dough forms. Transfer the warm dough into a piping bag or a sturdy zip-top bag with a bottom corner snipped off. 4. In a small bowl, whisk together orange juice, orange zest, gochujang, honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Pour into a small saucepan over medium heat and simmer for 3–4 minutes until it reduces into a sticky, bright orange glaze. Turn off the heat and stir in sesame oil. Set aside. 5. Heat 2 inches of neutral oil in a deep pan to 325°F (165°C). Pipe short strands of potato dough directly into the hot oil, using kitchen scissors to snip them off. Fry in small batches for 2–3 minutes until puffed, cooked through, and very pale golden. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels for at least 5 minutes. 6. Increase the oil temperature to 375°F (190°C). Return the par-fried potatoes to the oil in small batches and fry for 1–2 minutes until deeply golden brown and extra crispy on the outside. Drain briefly. 7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately alongside the spicy orange glaze for dipping. #recipe #cooking #asmr #foodtok

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! It’s one of those meals that looks impressive but is ridiculously easy to make! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! All credit to @allyssainthekitchen for this incredible recipe! 🤎 SAVE THIS ONE because I promise you’ll be making it again and again! #SundayDinner #ChickenThighs #EasyDinnerIdeas #HomeCooking #DinnerRecipes

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. UN APAGÓN MASIVO DEJA A OSCURAS BUENA PARTE DE CASABLANCA: INVESTIGAN UN POSIBLE CIBERATAQUE Un importante apagón ha afectado este miércoles, 11 de noviembre, a numerosos barrios de Casablanca, la capital económica de Marruecos, dejando sin suministro eléctrico a viviendas, comercios y diferentes instalaciones de la ciudad. La interrupción también ha provocado problemas de tráfico, fallos en semáforos y dificultades en las comunicaciones. El corte comenzó alrededor de las 16:48 horas y afectó a zonas como Maârif, Sidi Belyout, Bourgogne, Californie, Aïn Chock, Hay Hassani y el centro de Casablanca. También se registraron interrupciones en localidades próximas, entre ellas Bouskoura y Dar Bouazza. Las imágenes difundidas desde la ciudad muestran amplias zonas sin iluminación mientras los servicios técnicos trabajan para recuperar la normalidad. En las primeras horas circularon especulaciones sobre un posible ciberataque contra la infraestructura eléctrica marroquí. Sin embargo, la compañía regional de servicios Casablanca-Settat ha explicado que el incidente se produjo en líneas de muy alta tensión pertenecientes a la red nacional de transporte eléctrico. Según la información comunicada por la empresa, la avería estuvo relacionada con las fuertes rachas de viento y las tormentas que afectaron a la región. El problema interrumpió la alimentación de varias subestaciones que suministran electricidad a distintos sectores de la metrópoli. La falta de corriente dejó semáforos fuera de servicio, provocó dificultades de circulación y obligó a algunos establecimientos a interrumpir su actividad. Los equipos de Casablanca-Settat y de la Oficina Nacional de Electricidad y Agua Potable (ONEE) iniciaron las reparaciones para restablecer el suministro. A lo largo de la tarde y la noche, varios barrios comenzaron a recuperar la electricidad. Fuente: Hespress / Medi1news #CostaDelTerror #Casablanca #Marruecos #Apagon #Ciberseguridad

🥩🍲 Slow Cooker Garlic Butter Beef & Onion Gravy This tender, juicy slow-cooked beef is the ultimate comfort food! Thick, beautifully browned pieces of beef simmer low and slow in a rich, savory garlic butter gravy with sweet caramelized onions. Every piece is coated in a delicious, glossy sauce that makes this dish absolutely irresistible. The slow cooking process allows the beef to soak up all those incredible flavors until it's fork-tender and incredibly juicy. It's the kind of hearty, homemade dinner that fills the kitchen with an amazing aroma and brings everyone to the table. ❤️ 🥘 Ingredients 2 lbs beef chuck steak or boneless beef roast, sliced into thick pieces 2 large onions, sliced 4 cloves garlic, minced 3 tbsp butter 2 cups beef broth 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp tomato paste 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper Salt to taste 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water (optional) 👩‍🍳 Instructions Season the beef with salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder. Heat a skillet with a little oil and sear the beef on both sides until nicely browned. Place sliced onions and minced garlic in the slow cooker. Arrange the browned beef over the onions. Mix beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, and tomato paste. Pour over the beef. Add butter on top, cover, and cook on LOW for 7–8 hours or HIGH for 4–5 hours, until fork-tender. If desired, thicken the gravy with the cornstarch mixture during the final 20–30 minutes. Spoon that rich, flavorful onion gravy over the beef and serve hot! 😍 Perfect with creamy mashed potatoes, buttery rice, or warm dinner rolls to soak up every drop of that delicious gravy! Would you save this recipe for your next cozy family dinner? #SlowCookerBeef #BeefRecipes #ComfortFood #GarlicButterBeef #CrockpotRecipes #EasyDinner #HomemadeCooking #FamilyMeals #USAReels

Recipe Name: Slow Cooker Smothered Chicken with Creamy Onion Gravy Ingredients 1. 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs 2. 1 tsp salt 3. 1 tsp black pepper 4. 1 tsp garlic powder 5. 1 tsp onion powder 6. 1 cup all-purpose flour 7. 3 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 large onion, thinly sliced 9. 3 cups chicken broth 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 2 tbsp butter 12. 1 tsp dried thyme 13. 1 tbsp cornstarch 14. 2 tbsp water Recipe 1. Season the chicken thighs with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. 2. Lightly dredge each piece in flour, shaking off excess. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken on both sides until golden. 5. Transfer the chicken to a slow cooker. 6. Add sliced onions over the chicken. 7. Pour in chicken broth and sprinkle with thyme. 8. Cover and cook on LOW for 5-6 hours. 9. Remove the chicken carefully and keep warm. 10. Stir heavy cream and butter into the cooking liquid. 11. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl. 12. Stir the slurry into the gravy and cook until thickened. 13. Return the chicken to the slow cooker and coat with the gravy. 14. Let cook for another 15 minutes. 15. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, rice, or biscuits. Follow for more delicious recipes and easy family dinner ideas.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

Here's an Italian dish you might not know about. If you've never had gnudi, think of them as the soft, pillowy filling of ravioli, just without the pasta! They're traditionally made with ricotta, often with spinach, but I wanted to give them a little fall twist with roasted butternut squash. And of course, I had to finish them with brown butter and crispy sage. An aquarium’s filter does far more than keep the water looking clean. It continuously removes waste, circulates oxygen, and provides a home for beneficial bacteria that break down harmful toxins produced by fish and uneaten food. Without proper filtration, ammonia and other toxic compounds can quickly build up, turning a healthy aquarium into a dangerous environment for its inhabitants. A good filtration system helps maintain water quality, stabilize the ecosystem, and keep fish healthy over the long term. While decorations and lighting may catch the eye, the filter is the unseen engine that keeps the entire aquarium alive.

🍫 Knock Me Naked Cake A rich, chocolatey Butterfinger poke cake loaded with sweetened condensed milk, Cool Whip, and caramel! Ingredients 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food Cake Mix 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1 stick butter, melted 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger candy bars, crushed 2 containers Cool Whip Caramel sauce, for drizzling Instructions 1. Prepare the cake: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Mix together the cake mix, eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. 2. Bake: Bake for 29–30 minutes, depending on your oven, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 3. Poke & pour: While the cake is still warm, poke holes all over the top. Pour the entire can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over the cake, allowing it to soak into the holes. 4. Add the Butterfingers: Crush the entire bag of fun-size Butterfinger candy bars. Sprinkle half of the crushed candy over the cake and save the remaining half for topping. 5. Cool completely: Allow the cake to cool completely before adding the topping. 6. Finish it off: Spread both containers of Cool Whip evenly over the cake. Sprinkle the remaining crushed Butterfingers on top and finish with a generous drizzle of caramel sauce. 7. Refrigerate & serve: Cover and store the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Keep any leftovers refrigerated. 🤎 Kalyn’s Tip: This cake is delicious served cold! Give it time to chill so all that sweetened condensed milk can soak into the chocolate cake. #KnockMeNakedCake #ButterfingerCake #PokeCake #SouthernDesserts #EasyDessert

Cream chicken over biscuits with loaded bacon green beans! Such an easy comfort food dinner, and the homemade gravy is so good. I served mine over mashed potatoes with Cheddar Bay Biscuits on the side, but you can serve it right over the biscuits, too! Cream Chicken Over Biscuits Recipe Ingredients: 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp all purpose flour 2 cups water or chicken broth 1 tsp chicken bouillon Cheddar Bay Biscuits, prepared according to package instructions Mashed potatoes, for serving Seasonings: Dried parsley Garlic powder Onion powder Poultry seasoning Paprika Directions: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Add the flour and stir well, letting it cook for about 2 minutes. Pour in the water or chicken broth and stir until smooth. Season to taste with parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, poultry seasoning, and paprika. Stir in the chicken bouillon and give everything a good stir. I skipped adding salt because the bouillon was salty enough! Let the gravy simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until it starts to thicken. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken and stir until everything is combined. Cover and let simmer for several minutes until the chicken is heated through and the gravy thickens to your liking. Prepare the Cheddar Bay Biscuits according to the package instructions. Serve the chicken gravy over mashed potatoes with biscuits on the side, or spoon it right over the biscuits! Loaded Bacon Green Beans Recipe Ingredients: 2 cans green beans, drained 2 slices thick cut bacon, chopped 1 tbsp butter 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp low sodium soy sauce Garlic powder Black pepper Directions: Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Leave the bacon and bacon grease in the pan, then add the butter, drained green beans, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper. Stir everything together, cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, while you prepare the rest of dinner. Let the flavors come together until the green beans are tender! Save this one for your next weeknight dinner! #EasyDinnerIdeas #DinnerRecipes #WeeknightDinner #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe

Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Sadece 3 temel malzeme ile dışı çıtır, içi akışkan, uzadıkça uzayan harika bir atıştırmalık hazırlayabilirsiniz. 😍 Malzemeler: 1 adet taze yumurta 350g kaliteli rendelenmiş kaşar (veya mozzarella peyniri) 3 dolu yemek kaşığı nişasta Hazırlanışı: Tüm malzemeleri derin ve temiz bir kaba alarak, tamamen bütünleşip pürüzsüz bir hamur dokusuna ulaşana kadar güzelce yoğurun. Hamurdan ceviz büyüklüğünde, pürüzsüz parçalar koparıp yuvarlayın. Hazırladığınız topları kızgın yağda, her tarafı altın sarısı bir renk alana kadar kımkar kadar kontrollü bir şekilde kızartın. (Püf Noktası: Yağınızın ideal sıcaklıkta olması kritik önem taşır; böylece peynirler dışarı sızmadan hemen mühürlenir ve çıtırlaşır!) 📌 Bu tarifi denemek için kaydetmeyi ve sevdiklerinizle paylaşmayı unutmayın! Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

Recipe Name Honey Garlic Chicken with Creamy Parmesan Penne Ingredients 1. 2 large chicken breasts, sliced 2. 12 oz (340 g) penne pasta 3. 2 tbsp olive oil 4. 2 tbsp butter 5. 4 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 cup heavy cream 11. 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1/2 cup chicken broth 13. 1 tbsp honey 14. 1 tbsp soy sauce 15. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 16. 1 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne until al dente. Drain and set aside. 2. Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and slice. 4. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Stir in the honey, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, and chicken broth. Simmer for 2 minutes. 6. Add the heavy cream and cook over medium heat until slightly thickened. 7. Stir in the Parmesan cheese until smooth and creamy. 8. Toss the cooked penne into the sauce, coating every piece evenly. 9. Return the sliced chicken to the skillet and spoon some sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 2 minutes to blend the flavors. 11. Garnish with chopped parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. 12. Serve hot with garlic bread or a fresh salad. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. 💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. My sister-in-law’s famous Thanksgiving mashed potatoes 🥔 I’m also releasing a completely free Thanksgiving cookbook with recipes for every staple Thanksgiving dish you need for the big day. Everything is easy and doable without sacrificing flavor. Coming very soon, so follow my page so you don’t miss it Ingredients • 5 lb Yukon gold potatoes • 16 oz cream cheese, softened • ⅓ cup sour cream • ½ cup milk • 1 stick butter, softened, plus extra slices for topping • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp salt • Paprika, for topping • 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped Instructions 1. Set out the cream cheese and butter to soften. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Boiling Method: Peel the potatoes and cut into evenly sized chunks. Place in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until fork-tender. 3. Instant Pot Method (Alternative): Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot and place the trivet inside. Add the whole, unpeeled potatoes. Pressure cook on high for 14 minutes, then allow a 10-minute natural pressure release before releasing the remaining pressure. Carefully remove, cool slightly, and peel. Cook in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer cooked potatoes to a large mixing bowl. Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper. 5. Use a hand mixer or stand mixer to mix until smooth and creamy, being careful not to overmix. 6. Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. 7. Sprinkle paprika over the top and add a few thin slices of butter. 8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. 9. Bake at 400°F for 60 minutes, or until heated through. 10. Remove the foil during the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 11. Sprinkle the freshly chopped chives over the top before serving. Make-Ahead Instructions 1. Prepare the mashed potatoes following steps 1–8 above, using either cooking method. Wait to preheat the oven until you’re ready to bake. 2. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. 3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. 4. Preheat oven to 400°F. 5. Bake covered for approximately 60 minutes, until hot in the center. 6. Remove foil for the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 7. Sprinkle with the chopped chives before serving. #mashedpotatoes #EasyRecipe

Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers!!!  Tender chicken coated in a honey garlic soy sauce with sautéed peppers. Sticky, savory, and perfect over rice!!!  Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers  2 large chicken breast  Neutral oil  1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp soy 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp cornstarch  Sauce  Bell peppers, sliced (for sautéing) 1 tsp ginger paste or grated  2 tbsp garlic paste  2 tbsp honey  1/4 cup light and dark soy combined  1 tsp rice seasoning  1 tbsp hoisin sauce  1/2 tbsp oyster sauce  1/2 tsp Totole Granulated Chicken Flavor Season the chicken with neutral oil, seasonings, and cornstarch. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Cook the chicken in a skillet 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the sliced peppers until they reach your desired texture, then add the garlic paste. Pour in the sauce and simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add a 1:1 cornstarch slurry to thicken. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together until coated. Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. 8 FREAKY tips to lose Fat faster 👇🏻 1️⃣ Eat protein first at every meal When you start with protein before carbs or fats, you stay fuller longer, reduce cravings later, and burn more calories digesting it compared to other foods. 2️⃣ Drink a full glass of water 15-20 minutes before meals Takes up space in your stomach so you naturally eat less. Most people are also mildly dehydrated, which your brain confuses for hunger. 3️⃣ Digestion walks are a cheat code A quick 5 minute walk after eating helps push carbs into your muscles instead of fat storage and keeps your blood sugar from spiking. Easy, free, no gym required. 4️⃣ Micro movements Tapping your foot, pacing on calls, taking the long route - these small movements burn more calories than you think and compound fast. 5️⃣ Sip hot water throughout the day Supports digestion and your body uses energy to bring it back to temperature. Small burn each time, but it adds up. 6️⃣ Use smaller plates and bowls Your brain judges fullness by how "done" your plate looks. A full small plate feels more satisfying than a half-empty big one, so you eat less without trying. 7️⃣ Sleep in a cold room (~65°F) Helps your body produce more brown fat overnight, which burns regular fat to keep you warm. You're literally burning extra calories while sleeping. 8️⃣ The 3-2-1 Rule Stop eating 3 hours before bed so your body can digest. Cut water 2 hours before bed so you're not up all night. EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Finish it off: Surround the burgers with crispy fries, garnish with parsley and serve immediately! Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

The Journey of Blockem Popem WoodBots ! Two years ago, I shared a video showcasing the first versions of my WoodBots—handmade figures crafted from recycled skateboards, each with a unique mechanical design and gameplay. I was just starting out, developing these creations from scratch. At that time, I only offered WoodBots made from recycled skateboards, but the process took so long because I didn’t have the right tools to streamline production. With the unwavering support of my community, friends, and family—especially my wife, niece, a few close friends, and my dad—I’ve been able to achieve so much since then. Despite the challenges, your patience and encouragement helped me keep pushing forward. One of my proudest moments was securing a patent pending for my WoodBot creations.  However, the journey hasn’t been without setbacks. As the demand for WoodBots grew, I found myself running out of time to finalize the patent. I even had a company step in to help, but it was the last week before the patent expired, and time just wasn’t on my side. After the patent lapsed, they cut contact and left me with no further response. But I’m not giving up. I’ve recently consulted with patent lawyers to explore what it would take to reestablish the patent for WoodBots. It’s a long road, but with your continued support, I believe I can get there. **How You Can Help:** - **Spread the Word:** Share this story and video from two years ago with your friends, family, and on social media. Every share helps bring more eyes to the WoodBots community. - **Support the WoodBot Movement:** Whether through purchasing a WoodBot or engaging with my content, every bit of interaction counts. - **Direct Assistance:** If anyone has experience in patent law or connections that might help me reestablish the patent for WoodBots, I’d be incredibly grateful for any advice or direction. I’m deeply thankful for the journey so far and for everyone who’s been a part of it. Here’s to reestablishing the future of WoodBots and continuing to create something unique together!

Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Place the rolls onto a baking sheet. Top with garlic butter, tomato pesto & remaining cheese. Bake for 10-15 minutes, or until golden brown. Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. Sweet, savory, and packed with bold garlic flavor 🧄🍗 — this Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken is sticky, caramelized perfection and comes together fast! ⸻ 🍗 Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken ⭐ Ingredients 	•	4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (or thighs) 	•	Salt & black pepper 	•	1 tsp paprika 	•	2 tbsp olive oil Garlic Brown Sugar Sauce: 	•	½ cup packed brown sugar 	•	4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	2 tbsp soy sauce 	•	1 tbsp Dijon mustard (optional, for depth) 	•	1 tbsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice 	•	½ tsp crushed red pepper (optional) ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Directions 	1.	Season chicken: Pat chicken dry and season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika. 	2.	Sear: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown. 	3.	Make sauce: In a bowl, whisk together brown sugar, garlic, soy sauce, mustard, vinegar, and red pepper flakes. 	4.	Simmer: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour sauce into skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken and simmer 5–7 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through. 	5.	Serve: Spoon extra caramelized garlic sauce over top before serving. ⸻ 🍽️ Serve With 	•	White or jasmine rice 	•	Roasted broccoli 	•	Mashed potatoes ⸻ ✨ Tips 	•	Chicken thighs stay extra juicy 	•	For thicker sauce, simmer a few extra minutes 	•	Add a splash of pineapple juice for a sweet tropical twist Sticky, garlicky, and perfectly sweet — a guaranteed weeknight favorite 💛 #foodie #foodtok #recipe #dinner #chicken

Howlin’ Ray’s Nashville Hot Chicken at Home 🔥 Howlin’ Ray’s at Home Part 1/3 Send this to your mom so she can make it for you ❤️‍🔥 Comeback Sauce + Nashville Hot Chicken & Waffles recipes dropping SOON 😎 Full detailed recipes in bio 🔗 — CONDENSED RECIPE 👇 1️⃣ MARINATE: Pound 2 boneless chicken thighs to ½” thick. Whisk 2 cups buttermilk, ½ cup pickle juice, 2 tbsp hot sauce (@Osmo Kitchen magic sauce), 1 egg, kosher salt, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, paprika, white pepper, cayenne & optional MSG. Add thighs + 6 tenders, cover & refrigerate at least 4 hours, ideally overnight. 2️⃣ COMEBACK SAUCE: Mix mayo, ketchup, hot sauce, Dijon, Worcestershire, lemon juice, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper & salt. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. FULL RECIPE DROPPING SOON 🔥 3️⃣ DOUBLE DREDGE: Mix 3 cups flour, 1 cup cornstarch, 1 tbsp baking powder, kosher salt, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, paprika, white pepper, cayenne & optional MSG. Drizzle in 3–4 tbsp chicken marinade and mix to create craggly bits. Dip chicken in marinade → press into flour → rest on a rack for 10 minutes to hydrate flour → repeat marinade + flour before frying. 4️⃣ FRY: Heat neutral oil to 350°F. Fry in batches: tenders about 3–5 minutes; thighs about 5–7 minutes, until golden, CWISPY & 165°F internal. Drain on a clean wire rack. 5️⃣ NASHVILLE HOT OIL: In a heatproof bowl, combine cayenne, paprika, dark brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, black pepper, kosher salt & optional MSG. Carefully ladle in 1–1½ cups hot fry oil & whisk for 1-2 minutes to let bloom. Dunk or brush onto chicken. 6️⃣ SERVE: Enjoy with comeback sauce—or pile onto a buttered, toasted brioche bun with slaw, dill pickles & extra sauce. Serve immediately and enjoy, friends :) — #howlinrays #nashvillehotchicken #friedchicken #comebacksauce #recipe

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

SINGLE SERVE MOLTEN CHOCOLATE LAVA CAKE 🌋 Grab the recipe below ⬇️  * 1/4 cup semisweet or dark chocolate chips (~1.7oz) * 1 tablespoon unsalted butter * 3 tablespoons white granulated sugar * 1 egg * 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract * 2 tablespoons all purpose flour, spooned and leveled * Pinch kosher salt 1. Preheat your oven to 425°F and well grease a large ramekin with butter (mine was 10 ounces to top rim and about 4.25 inches wide) and dust with cocoa powder. Make sure to do this generously, especially on the bottom, so the cake easily releases. 2. Melt the chocolate chips and butter. You can do this in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10 second intervals, stirring in between each one, until melted. Set aside to cool. 3. In a mixing bowl, whisk together the sugar, egg, and vanilla until combined and foamy. Then whisk in the flour until smooth. 4. Add the cooled, melted chocolate and gently fold/stir until combined. 5. Pour the batter into the greased ramekin and bake for 13-15 minutes. The edges will be set and it will be slightly puffed in the middle but the middle will still feel soft if you gently press on it. Do not over bake or you lose that ‘lava’ texture. 6. AIR FRYER VARIATION - Air fry at 370 degrees for 8-10 minutes. The edges will be set and it will be puffed in the middle but the middle will still feel soft if you gently press on it. Do not over bake or the molten center will cook and lose that ‘lava’ texture.  7. After baking, run a knife around the edges to loosen it and let it rest for 3-4 minutes before trying to remove. Place a plate over the ramekin and carefully flip it upside down. Wait for about 20-30 seconds before lifting up the ramekin and the cake should remain on the plate. 8. I like to dust with a little powdered sugar and/or serve with a scoop of ice-cream. Enjoy immediately while still warm. #singleservedessert #singleserverecipe #singleservecake #chocolatelavacake

The chicken dinner that has MILLIONS of views is back! 🤯 And honestly, there’s a reason this recipe has gone so viral! It’s simple, comforting, absolutely delicious, and one of those meals everyone needs in their recipe collection! Not everyone grew up learning how to cook, and that’s exactly why I love sharing easy, home-cooked meals like this! ❤️ My daughter was craving stuffing and cranberry sauce, so we basically had Thanksgiving dinner on a random Tuesday, and nobody was complaining! 😂 Recipe inspired by @allyssainthekitchen! 🍗 VIRAL BAKED CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: * Boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Olive oil * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Paprika * Italian seasoning * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cups chicken broth * Fresh thyme * Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil, add all seasonings, and toss to coat evenly. 3. Add sliced onion, chicken broth, and fresh thyme. 4. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 5. Remove from oven and increase temperature to 450°F. 6. Remove thyme and carefully pour the cooking liquid into a bowl or measuring cup. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then whisk it into the cooking liquid to make your gravy. 7. Pour the gravy back over the chicken. 8. Return to the oven, uncovered, for another 30 minutes at 450°F, until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is beautifully browned! Serve over mashed potatoes with your favorite sides and ENJOY! If you love easy, family-friendly dinners that taste like you’ve been cooking all day, make sure you’re following along! I’ve got so many more recipes to share! Recipe Name: Garlic Parmesan Baked Chicken Breasts Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (2 lbs) 2. 3 tbsp olive oil 3. 4 cloves garlic, minced 4. 1 tsp salt 5. 1/2 tsp black pepper 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp dried thyme 8. 1 tsp dried rosemary 9. 1 cup Parmesan cheese, grated 10. 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 11. 2 tbsp butter, melted 12. 1 tbsp lemon juice Recipe 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). 2. Pat chicken breasts dry with paper towels. 3. Mix olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, and melted butter in a bowl. 4. Season chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, thyme, and rosemary. 5. Place chicken in a greased baking dish. 6. Brush the garlic mixture evenly over each chicken breast. 7. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese generously on top. 8. Bake for 25–30 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F internally. 9. Spoon pan juices over the chicken halfway through cooking. 10. Broil for 2–3 minutes for a golden crust. 11. Remove from oven and rest for 5 minutes. 12. Garnish with fresh parsley. 13. Serve with vegetables, rice, or potatoes. 14. Pour cream of mushroom soup over raw beef stew meat, along with 2 other ingredients, into a glass casserole dish for a cozy dinner that’s my default. Ingredients 2 pounds beef stew meat cut into 1- to 1 1/2-inch cubes 2 10.5-ounce cans condensed cream of mushroom soup 1 1-ounce packet dry onion soup mix 1/2 cup water Instructions Preheat & Prep: Preheat your oven to 300°F (150°C). Lightly grease a 9×13-inch glass casserole dish with a bit of oil or cooking spray to prevent sticking. Add Beef: Spread the raw beef stew meat evenly in the bottom of the glass casserole dish, breaking up any pieces that are stuck together so they cook evenly. Mix Sauce: In a medium bowl, whisk together the condensed cream of mushroom soup, dry onion soup mix, and water until mostly smooth. It doesn’t need to be perfect—just well combined so the flavors are distributed. Pour Sauce: Pour the cream of mushroom soup mixture evenly over the raw beef stew meat in the glass casserole dish, making sure all the meat is coated. Use a spatula or spoon to gently nudge the sauce into the corners and around the edges if needed. Cover: Cover the glass casserole dish tightly with aluminum foil to trap moisture and help the beef become tender as it bakes. Bake: Bake in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the beef is very tender when pierced with a fork and the sauce has thickened into a creamy gravy. Avoid uncovering frequently, as that releases steam and can slow down the cooking. Stir: Carefully remove the casserole dish from the oven and take off the foil, watching out for hot steam. Give the beef and sauce a gentle stir to re-coat the pieces and even out the texture of the gravy. Rest & Serve: Taste and adjust seasoning if desired (the onion soup mix is salty, so you may not need additional salt). Let the dish rest for about 5 minutes, then serve the creamy mushroom beef over mashed potatoes, noodles, or rice.
